rule.zh: 参考集原样保留；同一恢复阶段上被更短机制支配的剪除（同阶段取最小值，不相加）；其余在判定规模（研究中最大的规模）上各拓扑的 A_op Shapley 均 ≥ 阈值 → A_op 候选，有效产出 Shapley 均 ≥ 阈值 → 只保有效产出，否则剪除
rule.en: reference set kept as is; a mechanism dominated by a shorter one on the same recovery stage is pruned (minimum on a stage, never the sum); otherwise A_op Shapley ≥ threshold at the decision scale (the largest scale studied) on every architecture → A_op candidate, delivered Shapley ≥ threshold → goodput-only, else pruned

parameters.source: ReMAP f53ab7e packages/contracts/src/audit-extensions.ts: extensionScenario() generic fields (eligibleShare 1, or 0.5 of the CORE silent risk for D-SDC-FP8 / FP4; success 0.95; failureSeconds 0; overhead 0, D-ABFT 0.001) + parameterSets (R-LINK-LOCAL pause 2 s; R-FABRIC-DEGRADE pause 2 s, exposed communication 0.3, remaining bandwidth 0.75, repair 1,800 s; H-CONTROL-CONTINUITY pause 1 s; R-WARM-PROCESS / R-RUNTIME-SNAPSHOT startup 20 / 15 s; R-CANN-GRAPH graph 7.5 s; C-ASYNC block 1 s, lag 10 s; C-LOSSLESS ratio 2, decompress 10 s; D-RECOVERY-CLASSIFY manual 0.001; D-SDC-FP8 / FP4 coverage 0.95 in 1 s; D-ABFT conditional coverage 0.9; D-NET-SDC coverage 0.95 in 1 s; H-SDC-SCREEN reduction 0.25; R-HCCL-ELASTIC communication 15 s), eligibility × success folded by expectation where the transform is deterministic (riskShare 0.5 × 0.95, conditionalMissDetection 0.9 × 0.95, D-NET-SDC 0.95 × 0.95, C-ASYNC 4 × 0.05 + 1 × 0.95)
parameters.note: ReMAP labels them an explicit scenario (evidence “scenario”, “never a measured default”); reconciled against the file 2026-10-21, all 15 blocks agree

baseline.source: ReMAP reference set (mechanism-policy.json of the expert review 2026-10-09): D-SDC, R-SDC, R-REPLAY, R-PROCESS, R-ELASTIC, C-FAST with the library’s parameters (scripts/remap-param-check.ts: SAME)

candidates.source: pruning rule on the four built-in records’ Shapley studies at 500k (docs/backup/arch-mechanism-shapley, 300 permutations): A_op Shapley ≥ 0.15 pt on every architecture, not dominated on a shared stage (hacd prune reproduces the lists)

goodputOnly.source: pruning rule: delivered-goodput Shapley ≥ 0.15 pt on every architecture, A_op below the threshold

pruned.source: pruning rule: dominated on the startup stage (R-WARM-PROCESS, R-CANN-GRAPH by R-RUNTIME-SNAPSHOT) or below the threshold on both metrics

levers.source: HAC-D v4 allocation strategies (docs/markdown/PLAN_V4_NPU_TOPOLOGY_FIRST.md §8, packages/core/src/strategy DEFAULT_LEVERS): automatic attempt ≥ 60 s, automatic success ≤ 99.9 %, manual recovery ≥ 30 min; efforts 3 / 3 / 2 are engineering judgement

derate.source: HAC-D derated yardstick (packages/core/src/mechanisms/plan.ts DERATE_DEFAULT): coverage, detection targets and shares −5 pt, success −8 pt, times and overheads × 1.5, rate reductions × 0.5 — engineering margins

efforts.source: library efforts 1–5 per mechanism (MechanismDef.effort, the audit catalog’s integration effort), not overridden by this set

prune.threshold.source: 0.15 pt chosen above the sampled Shapley 95 % half-width at 500k (≤ 0.25 pt per the stored studies, ≤ 0.12 pt on most mechanisms); borderline verdicts (R-FABRIC-DEGRADE, min 0.19 pt) are re-checked by hacd prune when parameters change

prune.dominated.source: audit library overlap rule: mechanisms on one recovery stage take the minimum time (R-WARM-PROCESS 20 s and R-CANN-GRAPH 37.5 s startup vs R-RUNTIME-SNAPSHOT 15 s)
